status_effects.explanation: She is the object of a charming, admiring compliment from Swann, delivered before witnesses.
Her naive, literal misunderstanding of Swann's wit marks her as socially/intellectually outmatched in the exchange.

appraisal_events.evidence: voici la charmante princesse !... quelques petits fruits de prunier des oiseaux et d'aubépine... C'est très joli, ma chère princesse.
appraisal_events.explanation: Swann pays the princesse a poetic, admiring compliment on her appearance, comparing her to a pretty songbird decked in blossoms, distinct from the narrator's separate praise of Swann's own rhetorical skill.

appraisal_events.evidence: s'écria naïvement Mme de Saint-Euverte qui était peu habituée au tour d'esprit de Swann... Mais comment la princesse pouvait-elle connaître mon programme !
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator marks Mme de Saint-Euverte's flustered, literal misreading of Swann's figurative compliment as naive and out of step with his wit, comically deflating her poise before the group.
